name: Promotional Review (PRC/MLR)
one_liner: Content review with claims validation, reference checks, fair balance and versioned approvals.
fits_when: brand teams submit detail aids, HCP emails, web pages or patient leaflets for approval before use
every promotional claim must be substantiated by a reference, down to the page
medical, legal and regulatory reviewers each sign off, often in parallel and within an SLA
materials are versioned and a rejected version goes back to the brand with comments
approved materials carry a job code, an expiry date and need recertification or withdrawal
reviewers should see only the reviews assigned to them
gives_you: Material submissions with type, channel, audience, artwork, fair balance and PI checks
Claims tied to references, substantiated or rejected claim by claim by the medical reviewer
Medical, legal and regulatory reviews routed by an MLR coordinator, with outcomes and comments
Approval with job code and expiry, expiring-soon flags, and withdrawal of expired material
Reference library with re-review flags when a cited reference is superseded
Material 360 page with claims, reviews, versions and activity in one place

catalogue.description: Promotional material review from submission to expiry: brand managers submit materials with their claims and references, an MLR coordinator routes each version to medical, legal and regulatory reviewers, every claim is checked against its reference and for fair balance, and the approved version gets a job code and an expiry date. The app is described in the Zango app spec and previewed live as a clickable app with demo data while the requirement is shaped.

compliance: Every claim substantiated by a referenced source before approval
Fair balance and abbreviated prescribing information checked on every HCP material
Versioned approvals with job code, certifier and expiry date
Audit trail of every submission, review outcome and status change
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Promotional review app where brand managers submit detail aids, HCP emails and patient leaflets with every claim linked to a reference page. An MLR coordinator routes each version to medical, legal and regulatory reviewers within a 5-working-day SLA, and the medical reviewer substantiates claims one by one. The regulatory head certifies the final version, which gets a job code and a 24-month expiry with annual recertification. Certified PDFs go to our document management system and the reviewer roster syncs from the HR directory.

changelog: First version: promotional review (PRC/MLR) on the Zango app spec v1, with submissions, claim substantiation against references, medical, legal and regulatory review, and approval with expiry.
